response.text: The first query had a bad function call. I'll rerun the journal-balance and join checks cleanly, plus a look at the AP-to-journal link and the one paid invoice without a full payment.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'jrnl_unbalanced' chk, COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT"))>0.005) x UNION ALL SELECT 'apinvh_jrnl_no_missing_header', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'apinvh_jrnl_is_AP_src', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."SRC_CD"='AP' UNION ALL SELECT 'apinvh_vend_missing', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'gljrnl_acct_missing', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'gljrnh_prd_missing', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'apinvh_inv_dt_in_bad_format', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE LENGTH("INV_DT"::text)<>8 UNION ALL SELECT 'gljrnl_negative_or_both', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 OR ("DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0);

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_AMT", p.paid, i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", SUM("PAY_AMT") paid FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY "INV_ID") p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND ABS(p.paid-i."INV_AMT")>=0.005 LIMIT 5;

SELECT p."PRD_ID", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."PRD_ID"=p."PRD_ID") jrnls, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."PRD_ID"=p."PRD_ID" AND h."POST_DT" BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT") jrnls_in_range FROM "GLPERD" p ORDER BY p."PRD_ID";
